name: io.github.Ventrova/sentinel-scan-cli
description: Static, offline heuristic security scanner for MCP server manifests, mapped to the OWASP MCP Top 10 (tool description/name injection, excessive agency, command injection, hardcoded credentials, unpinned sources, wildcard scopes, missing HITL confirmation, hidden unicode, cross-origin exfiltration, DoS risk, definition drift). No server execution, no network calls, no LLM calls.
title: Sentinel Scan
